hooks.command: sh -c 'file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then case "$file" in *.ts|*.js|*.json) corepack pnpm biome check --write --diagnostic-level=error --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.vue|*.md|*.css|*.html|*.yml|*.yaml) corepack pnpm prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; fi; if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi'
